1 The displays have rounded corners. When measured diagonally as a rectangle, the 13″ iPad Pro is 33.02 cm (13″), the 12.9″ iPad Pro is 32.77 cm (12.9″), the 11″ iPad Pro (M4 and M5) is 28.22 cm (11.1″), the 11″ iPad Pro (1st–4th generation) is 27.96 cm (11″), the 13″ iPad Air is 32.78 cm (12.9″), the 11″ iPad Air and iPad (A16) are 27.59 cm (10.86″), the 10.9″ iPad Air and iPad (10th generation) are 27.58 cm (10.86″), the 8.5″ iPad mini (A20 Pro) is 21.59 cm (8.5″) and the 8.3″ iPad mini (A17 Pro) is 21.08 cm (8.3″). Actual viewable area is less.
2 Apple Intelligence is available with Siri and device language set to Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Danish, Dutch, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Portuguese, Spanish, Swedish, Turkish or Vietnamese. Some features may not be available in all regions or languages. Some devices may not be available in all regions. Siri AI is available in beta in iPadOS 27 and requires an Apple Intelligence–enabled device set to a supported language. Available in English, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish to start. Siri AI will not be initially available in the EU on iPadOS. Siri AI is not available for users under 13. Certain Apple Intelligence features that rely on server-side models are subject to daily usage limits, including but not limited to Siri AI, Intelligent Photo Editing Tools, Image Playground and AFM 3 Cloud models in Shortcuts. Daily limits may vary by feature, request complexity, system demand, system policies and other factors. Expanded access to such features will be available for a fee in the future. Use of these features is subject to the Apple Intelligence Terms and Conditions. Learn more at support.apple.com/en-in/148587 .
3 Wi‑Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7 are available in countries and regions where supported.
4 Data plan is required. 5G, Gigabit LTE, Gigabit-class LTE, LTE Advanced, LTE and Wi-Fi calling are available in selected markets and through selected carriers. Speeds are based on theoretical throughput and vary based on site conditions and carrier. For details on 5G and LTE support, contact your carrier and see apple.com/in/ipad/cellular .
5 Requires USB-C to Apple Pencil Adapter.
6 Actual formatted capacity is less and varies due to many factors. Storage capacity is subject to change based on software version, settings and iPad model. 1GB = 1 billion bytes; 1TB = 1 trillion bytes.
7 Size and weight vary by conﬁguration and manufacturing process.
8 Battery life varies by use and configuration. See apple.com/in/batteries for more information.
9 Testing conducted by Apple in August and September 2025 using pre-production iPad Pro 11″ (M5) and iPad Pro 13″ (M5) units, and USB‑C Charge Cable with Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max (Model A3351) or Apple 70W USB-C Power Adapter (Model A2743). Fast-charge testing conducted with drained iPad Pro units. Times measured from the appearance of the Apple logo as the unit started up. Charge time varies with settings and environmental factors; actual results will vary.
10 Testing conducted by Apple in September 2026 using pre-production iPad mini (A20 Pro) units, and USB‑C Charge Cable with Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max (Model A3351) or Apple 35W Dual USB‑C Port Compact Power Adapter (Model A2571). Requires an outlet that supports up to 1.5A at 100–240V, 50–60Hz. Fast‑charge testing conducted with drained iPad mini. Times measured from the appearance of the Apple logo as the unit started up. Charge time varies with settings and environmental factors; actual results will vary.
11 Cellular data plan is sold separately. The model you purchase is configured to work with a particular cellular network technology. Check with your carrier for compatibility and cellular data plan availability.
